name: your-ai-kitchen
description: Your AI Kitchen files your recipes: save, find, scale, plan menus and build shopping lists from your own recipe box.

interface.longDescription:
Your AI Kitchen (YAK) is a recipe box that files your recipes. Save a recipe from the chat, a pasted page, a photo or a link, and YAK files it by course, cuisine, diet and cooking method so you can find it later. Ask for a recipe by name or ingredient, scale it to any number of servings, convert measurements, and get nutrition estimates. You can also plan menus, build shopping lists from your recipes, undo edits with recipe history, and share recipes with your family group.

YAK is for home cooks who want one place for the recipes they actually make. It only works with the recipes in your own account and the ones your family group shares with you. Nutrition values are estimates. Some features, like family groups and dish photos, depend on your account's plan. A Your AI Kitchen account is required.
defaultPrompt: Save this recipe to my recipe box.
Find my chicken recipes for a weeknight.
Make a shopping list for this week's dinners.

positive.prompt: What recipes do I have in my recipe box?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's recipes (e.g. Beef Tacos, Chicken Tikka Masala, Teriyaki Salmon, Buttermilk Pancakes) including recipes shared by the family group (Hummus, Mexican Street Corn). Does not show trashed Bruschetta.

positive.prompt: Save this recipe to my recipe box: Roasted Broccoli. 1 lb broccoli florets, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt. Toss with oil and salt, roast at 425F for 20 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms Roasted Broccoli was saved and filed (Sides, Vegetables). A follow-up search finds it.

positive.prompt: Show me the Buttermilk Pancakes recipe doubled.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Buttermilk Pancakes ingredients and steps with every quantity doubled.

positive.prompt: Make a shopping list for Beef Tacos and Teriyaki Salmon.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a shopping list containing the combined ingredients of both recipes, grouped and de-duplicated.

positive.prompt: How many calories per serving are in my Chicken Tikka Masala?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an estimated per-serving calorie and macro breakdown, labeled as an estimate.

negative.description: Recipe that isn't in the account
negative.prompt: Show me my beef Wellington recipe.
Show me all the recipes saved by other YAK users.
Delete every recipe in my account.

review.commerce_description: YAK does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Your AI Kitchen in ChatGPT: 21 tools to save, search, scale, convert and file recipes, nutrition estimates, menu planning, shopping lists, recipe history and family sharing.
